The '''''Claw''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] crewed by former associates of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Butler (pirate)|Butler]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After Butler's death his crew became convinced that he had left behind a treasure on [[Butler's Cove]]. When they saw [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents piloting the ''[[Hard Shell]]'' away from the planet they mistakenly believed it to be hauling Butler's treasure, and they gave chase.<ref name="SN" />
